notes: *with a loud voice* keeps its supplied *with* and *a* on `קוֹל` under rules 33 and 15 rather than marking either word `added`; the unit is discontinuous around the adjective.
`כָּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל` writes no *of* between *all* and *the men*, so `כֹּל` keeps only its own word and the chain's one *of* goes to `יִשְׂרָאֵל` (rule 19).
